overview.title: Discover Tamtatouchte
overview.p1: Mountain village beyond the Todra Gorges — end of the canyon road and trailhead.
overview.p2: Tamtatouchte is a highlight of the Tinghir area on Morocco's desert route. Allow enough time to walk and take photos.
overview.p3: Combine with other Tinghir sites the same day. Wear sturdy shoes and carry water.

moods.title: Tamtatouchte through the day
moods.subtitle: When to go and what to expect.

1.title: Best light
1.desc: Cooler and quieter — ideal for photos and walks.

3.title: Softer light
3.desc: Warmer colours; calmer as groups leave.

food.title: Where to eat near Tamtatouchte
food.p1: Simple restaurants and cafés in Tinghir or near the site. Tagines, grills and mint tea.
food.p2: Cash is useful for small local places.

1.title: Access
1.desc: Road through the Todra Gorges continues to Tamtatouchte (~30–40 min from Tinghir).

2.title: Timing
2.desc: Early morning or late afternoon for fewer crowds and softer light.

3.title: Respect
3.desc: Respect villagers, gardens and the natural site.

q2.question: Is it suitable for children?
q2.answer: Yes with supervision near cliffs and uneven paths.

q3.question: Do I need a guide?
q3.answer: Recommended for mountain trails beyond the village; the road itself needs no guide.

q4.question: How to get there?
q4.answer: By road from Tinghir on the desert route.
